Introduction

Chu Yoon-jung, better known as Ash-B, is a South Korean rapper under REC. She debuted on September 5, 2014, under Stone Music Entertainment with the digital single "Who Here." She has appeared on the reality shows Unpretty Rapstar Seasons 2 and 3, and Show Me The Money 5.

Prior to using the stage name Ash‑B, she performed under the aliases Waze and ASH B Clz. Her debut EP "Brat of the Year" was released in 2021.
